Name: Akipana's Portraits - Combined Girls(Alex)
Author: MasterAki
Description:
This a simple portrait mod for the Combined Girls by Onmyoujin using the Portraiture Mod by Platonymous.

[b][size=4]The images are AI Generated, I know how much hate AI images get but I had to edit most of the images used here by hand. So you may look at it as a collaborative work between a person and ai. I just wanted to practice using various mods like Portraiture and maybe Fashion Sense when I have time....[/size][/b]

[i]'This only replaces Alex vanilla portraits... If a lot of people like the mod I might make it so its compatible with some seasonal outfit mods' [/i]

[b]If you guys want more for the other "bachelors" of the Combined Girls Mod , download this mod and add a comment so I know people like it!

[i]Check out my other Portraits:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21448]Akipana's Portraits - Combined Girls(Sabrina) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21771/]Akipana's Portraits - Combined Girls (Shane) at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url][/i]

[i]Steps to use the portraits:

- Unzip the file Alex - Vanilla Portraits.
-Copy or Cut the file to "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits".
-Enjoy the new portraits![/i]
[/b]
